name: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd
tagline: SME MICE / exhibitions services company growing ~40% with ~22-28% margins - asset-light and profitable, but an inherently cyclical, low-barrier events business with no structural path to a 10x
business_overview: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd (BSE SME: 543895, listed April 2023), incorporated 2010, is a 360-degree exhibition / MICE (meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions) company: event infrastructure (AC steel structures, octanorm systems, flooring, furniture, AV, branding/signage), integrated marketing and end-to-end event management, plus owned modular event inventory across ~5 cities. Recent tie-up with ICICI Lombard to promote exhibition insurance.
fundamentals_table: 2026-05-04 ICICI Lombard exhibition-insurance partnership; 2026-05-19 H2FY26 sales +23% YoY to Rs 100 Cr, net profit +15% YoY to Rs 23 Cr, OPM ~28%
fundamentals_narrative: Exhicon is a profitable, asset-light SME - FY26 revenue ~Rs 205 Cr (+40%), PAT ~Rs 45 Cr (+50%), ~25% margins, ~18x earnings. India's MICE / exhibitions market is growing and the company owns reusable event infrastructure that improves margins versus pure organisers. But this is a cyclical, low-barrier services business: revenue is event-calendar-dependent and lumpy (H2-weighted), competition is fragmented, and there is no recurring revenue base or proprietary moat. A 10x from ~Rs 812 Cr (to ~Rs 8,000 Cr) would require PAT to rise ~7x from ~Rs 45 Cr while the multiple holds - a demanding ask for an events company. The ValuePickr thread is empty, so there is no independent scrutiny.
